headline: Stars place Cameron Hughes on waivers
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that the Stars have placed Cameron Hughes on waivers. The outlet adds that Hughes hasn't played this season after suffering an upper-body injury in preseason.

For Dallas, the move says little about the team's strength. The Stars are 7-4-1 with 15 points through 12 games, and our numbers like how they're playing. They've taken 53.7% of the expected goals so far this season (expected goals measure the quality of chances, so that's a share of the better looks), and 54% at five-on-five. Their special teams hold up too: the power play generates 0.68 expected goals per game, and the penalty kill allows 0.56.

The split between results and process is the more interesting part. Dallas has scored 4.6 fewer goals than its chances would suggest, which points to some finishing bad luck, while goalies have saved 7.6 more goals than expected given the shots they faced. That has covered for the finishing. If the shooting evens out, this team should look even better than its record.
